newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech June CPI 1.2 pct mo/mo, 6.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Czech June CPI 1.2 pct mo/mo, 6.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Czech consumer prices rose 1.2 percent in June putting year-on-year inflation at 6.8 percent, the Czech Statistical Bureau (CSU) said on Monday.
CZECH CONSUMER INFLATION June 97 May 97 June 96
JUNE CPI BASKET COMPONENTS CHANGE MO/MO CHANGE YR/YR

NOTE- May basket component changes in brackets. All changes are rises except where stated. Prices have risen 26.6 percent from the average level for 1994 while the sliding average in June using a 1993 base was 7.9 percent. Basket of goods and services is unchanged from 1995.
The CSU said in a statement that core inflation in June accounted for +0.944 percent of total inflation, while the influence of price deregulation was +0.020 percent.
